text:
I'm sorry, that's a stressful mistake to catch late. Unfortunately, once an order has shipped, the shipping address can't be changed, and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy, so I'm not able to redirect it. Shipped orders also can't be cancelled.

My policy information doesn't cover other options for a package that's already on its way, such as intercepting it yourself with the courier or what happens if it's delivered to the wrong address. If you'd like, I can escalate this to a Support Lead to look into what else may be possible. Just send me your order number (it looks like LF- plus six digits).
